title: Missed concurrency guard in a GPT-written change
intent: Add `SeatMap.hold_many`, which holds a group of seats for one owner all-or-nothing. `SeatMap` is used from many threads.
checks: `python3 -m pytest -q` ran in the repository: 6 passed.

problems.summary: hold_many tests the held seats and the capacity before it takes the lock, so two threads can both pass the checks and then both write

locations.anchor: if any(seat in self._held for seat in wanted)
